summary: Offerpad Solutions filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary OP SPE Summit, LLC amended and restated its revolving loan agreement on October 7, 2026 with WHGG II Trust and Ascent Developer Solutions LLC, raising uncommitted borrowing capacity from $150 million to $200 million. The facility includes customary representations, covenants and default provisions permitting acceleration. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium or ownership change appears. This is a routine credit-facility modification, not a special situation; watch covenant compliance and funding availability given the borrower's real-estate inventory financing needs.
